title: Welcome to Velo Client Tester
summary: The first tester build: everything from 1.5.1 plus this Testing page. Try the new stuff below and tell us what works and what breaks - every answer goes straight to the team.
changes: New: the Testing page - see what changed in every tester build and report each item as works / broken
The Tester launcher updates itself when a new tester build is out
Custom Skybox: 8 skies with previews, sharp stars, real sun and moon
Lyrics react to the beat of your music, with 3D text and big-moment effects
Pets: sit & stay, tricks, first person, hidden while fighting

test.title: This Testing page
test.how: Answer each item here. Does it save when you come back later?

test.title: Custom Skybox
test.how: R-Shift > Custom Skybox > Choose Skybox... Try several skies at day and night. Are the stars sharp, are sun and moon right, are lyrics and water in front?

test.title: Lyrics on the beat
test.how: Play music (Spotify etc.), turn on Lyrics and beat sync in the Lyrics Studio. Do the effects hit on the beat?

test.title: Pets
test.how: Equip a pet, bind Stay and Trick in the controls, emote, fight something. Does it hide while fighting and come back?

test.title: Heart variants
test.how: Hearts module > draw a poison or wither heart variant with the colour picker.

test.title: Game start
test.how: Start each Minecraft version you play. Anything black, missing text or crashing?
